text:
alex: Quick heads-up — deploying model-routing change at 02:00 UTC. Plan is phased FF ramp for feature flag `llm_route_v4`. Will pin version `route-v4-2026-03-22` for the canary cohort.

maya: Thanks. What's the initial cohort size?

alex: Start at 0.5% for 10m, then 5% for 20m, then 25% for 30m if metrics are green. Quiet window 15m after each step.

samir: Which metrics are our gates? Latency P95, error rate, and token cost variance, right?

alex: Yup. Gate thresholds: P95 increase <= 15ms, errors <= 0.1% above baseline, token cost delta <= 3%. Also watch tail-latency spikes.

deploybot: deploybot: Scheduling deploy `route-v4-2026-03-22` to production at 2026-03-22T02:00:00Z. Canary -> 0.5% -> 5% -> 25% staged. Runbook: https://intranet.redwood/deploys/route-v4-2026-03-22

kim: I'll pin the fallback to `route-v3-lock` during the canary so we can instant drain back. Doing the pin now.

kim: pinned `route-v3-lock` for cohort `canary` ✅

maya: Suggest we enable a per-route rate cap while ramping to avoid overload. Set `llm_route_v4_ratecap=300rps` for the first two phases.

alex: Good call. Adding ramp-specific rate cap and a soft QPS limiter. Updated snippet for ops:

alex: ```json
{
  "flag": "llm_route_v4",
  "steps": [
    {"pct": 0.5, "duration_min": 10, "ratecap_rps": 300},
    {"pct": 5, "duration_min": 20, "ratecap_rps": 300},
    {"pct": 25, "duration_min": 30, "ratecap_rps": 1000}
  ],
  "rollback_on": ["p95>baseline+15ms", "errors>0.1%"],
  "pin_fallback": "route-v3-lock"
}
```

oncall-bot: oncall-bot: Notifying on-call: @samir oncall for infra this window.

samir: I'm on it. Will watch P95 and 5xxs. If P95 crosses +15ms or 5xx spike >0.1% for 5m, we roll back immediately and drain.

alex: Rollback plan: immediate disable FF (set pct to 0) + pin traffic to `route-v3-lock` + cancel any in-flight canary promotion. Deploybot runbook has CLI commands.

maya: Can someone run a dry toggle now against staging to sanity-check metric hooks? Small curl example: `curl -X POST https://ops-api/flags/llm_route_v4/toggle -d '{"pct":5}'`

kim: Doing staging check now. 

kim: staging toggle ok, metrics pipeline emits canary tag, alerting hooks fire. :thumbsup:

alex: ok great. Final checks: DB migrations none, schema unchanged, no config secret rotation. Ops: set the quiet window alerts to high sensitivity so pages fire early.

deploybot: deploybot: Preflight passed. Auto-schedule confirmed. I'll post live updates during the ramp in this thread.

samir: Acks. I'll stand by at deploy time. If anything looks off, call the rollback and tag this thread.

maya: Thanks all — will monitor model quality too (sampling prompts). Posting release note in #release-notes after the 25% step completes.

alex: Perfect. See you at 02:00 UTC, will update here when we hit each step. :rocket:
